title: RHEM - Runtime Hard-Example Mining for Agent Systems
description: RHEM is a runtime hard-example mining reference implementation for Agent systems. Version 0.7.0 adds an opt-in hibernation manager for observation, low-power hibernation, recurrence wake-up, manual wake-up, human-approved recycling, and drift-sample ledgers. Hibernation changes only record lifecycle state and remains patch-governed and rollback-capable. This release does not claim production performance, statistical optimality, or proven generalization gains.
notes: RHEM v0.7.0 is a repository release for opt-in hibernation lifecycle governance. Independent Zenodo version DOIs for v0.7.0 and v0.6.0 have not yet been generated; use the concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22681163 when citing these versions before archival. Previous version DOIs remain available: v0.5.1 is 10.5281/zenodo.22719758, v0.5.0 is 10.5281/zenodo.22719697, and v0.4.0 is 10.5281/zenodo.22719563.
